paragraphs.text:
“Ah, yes, well, that book is actually called the Book of the Undead! 
These mummies are real, my friend. They must be burned like so 
much offal or manure to be destroyed. Surely you’ve smelled that 
odor around the city, and have seen the troops racing about. That 
is one secret of Cairo which no one—not even the British—dares 
speak of.”
Why be alarmed? You’re safe enough, for the moment. Return 
to 237, or if you are finished here, go to 149.
(237)
